clue.text: Noise made by rapper with short cane at end of act

indicators.note: short means the cane word loses its final letter, cut down by one

parts.note: rattan is a cane made from a climbing palm

indicators.note: end of picks the closing letter of the word act

explanation.surface: Someone giving a knock on the door with a cut-down walking stick at the end of a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims RATTAN to RATTA; 'end of act' adds T. The rapper is a door-knocker, not a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: The sound of a door knocker being struck is conventionally written as a repeated sharp tapping.

clue.text: Build up a team of rowers that's sound

clue.text: High-class prizes coming up
